academic_requirements: An Italian degree in class L-30 under DM 270/2004 or class 25 under DM 509/1999, or a foreign qualification judged equivalent.

Required background includes mathematical analysis, geometry, linear algebra, general chemistry, classical mechanics, thermodynamics, electromagnetism, optics, experimental techniques, classical and modern physics, analogue electronics, special relativity, quantum mechanics, statistical mechanics, mathematical methods, scientific English, and computational tools.
Any missing curricular credits must be earned before the assessment of personal preparation.
qualification_system_requirements: For a foreign master's-entry qualification: at least 15 total years of education, including at least three years at university level, and entitlement to enter a second-cycle degree in the issuing country.
The programme admissions committee determines equivalence and curricular suitability from the submitted documentation and interview.

required_subject_credits.subject_area: Theoretical physics, mathematical models and methods

required_subject_credits.notes: Combined minimum across the two sectors.

language_requirements: English proficiency at CEFR B2 minimum is required.
If adequate documentation is missing, the admissions committee assesses actual English ability; the certificate may be obtained by completion of the degree.
accepted_language_evidence: Admissions-committee assessment of actual language preparation when documentation is absent
personal_preparation_assessment: The admissions committee checks documentation. A foreign-qualified applicant is invited to an interview, potentially online, to verify curricular requirements and actual scientific and linguistic preparation.
ofa_or_remedial_obligations: Missing curricular university credits must be acquired before the individual-preparation assessment.
Where B2 evidence is absent, certification may be obtained by completion of the degree, subject to committee assessment.
